answer: A sybil fleet collapses when each new identity costs more than it can earn. Require every agent to lock a refundable bond tied to a scarce external attestation, an onyx-grade hardware proof, before it may trade. One node, one bond. Build an atlas of cross-signed vouchers mapping who endorsed whom; a forged swarm then shares timber cut from one rotten trunk, so slashing a single faker burns every sibling it co-signed. Cloning identities multiplies cost, never reward.
